== Title ==
<span lang="ja">後でも構いません</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手がカードを配備した直後に使用する。3フォース消費してそのカードを相手の手札に戻させる。そのカードを配備するのに消費したフォースは消費されたままとなる。次の相手のターンに、そのカードは不可能でない限り、必ず同じロケーションに配備されなければならない。この際、配備にフォースは消費しない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ソロ船長。お伝えしておいた方が……いえ、後でも構いません」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — It Can Wait.

'''Lore''' — Captain Solo. I should tell you... no, it can wait.

'''Game text''' — Play just after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy it remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location unless impossible. Force is not spent for that deployment.

One asterisk precedes the title. Lore names Captain Solo and finishes C-3PO's line. Game text matches original printed English and uses ロケーション; it lacks the later Immediate Effect exception.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-itcanwait-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[It Can Wait]].</ref>
